blindSummary: An LGBTQ+ rights organisation's 2025 annual report issues a named warning of "increasing violence against LGBTQ+ people in this state/province", and quantifies it: 54 cases of intrafamily violence, 41 sexual offences, 12 discrimination cases, 8 digital-violence cases, 69 threats and 8 lethal-violence cases in this state/province, with 2 killings of LGBTQ+ human-rights defenders; the report designates the largest city and a second city as territories at "high" threat level. The largest city is the coastal hub for trans sex work and the city where the NGO's documentation base operates, giving it both elevated exposure and visibility in monitoring data; this state/province appears explicitly in the 270-victim national total (+63% on 2024; one killing every 32 hours). Impunity is near-total nationally: 99.8% of threat cases never advanced past the investigation stage. The state/province's development plan (and the largest city's) commits coordinated action with the prosecutor's office, police and judiciary to strengthen reporting, investigation and prosecution of violent acts against LGBTQ+ people.
blindSourceSummaries: A national daily's coastal-city edition (17 May 2026): an LGBTQ+ rights organisation's 2025 report on failures of protection (270 fatal victims nationally, +63% on 2024's 165 homicides, one killing every 32 hours) warns of rising violence including in this state/province - 54 intrafamily-violence cases, 41 sexual offences, 12 discrimination cases, 8 digital-violence cases, 69 threats, 2 homicides of defenders, 8 lethal-violence cases; the largest city and a second city named at "high" threat level; analysis of the state/province's and the largest city's development plans' coordinated actions with prosecutors, police and courts.

An LGBTQ+ rights organisation's 2025 report: structural crisis - one LGBTQ+ person killed every 32 hours; continuum of violence (discrimination to family violence to sexual violence to threats to homicide to impunity); 1,184 threat victims used as territorial-control mechanisms; 1,531 intrafamily-violence and 628 sexual-violence cases; digital violence (doxxing, identity theft, revenge porn) as escalation catalyst; violence concentrated in major urban centres with expansion into territories with armed actors and illegal economies; 160 information requests to public entities with widespread non-response.
blindLocalsOnly: The 54 intrafamily-violence cases, the two killings of community defenders and the digital-violence/doxxing displacement documented for 2025 are resident- and activist-facing rather than visitor-directed; the visitor-facing risk signal is the public-space lethality, impunity and named high-threat designation for the largest city.
